basic_details.job_title: KSFES Fire Station Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 16 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Karnataka State Fire and Emergency Services (KSFES), Bengaluru, has invited applications for 16 posts of Fire Station Officer under Advt No. ಸಿಬ್ಬಂದಿ(7)18/ನೇಮಕಾತಿ/2026. The online application is open from 23 November 2026 to 22 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online only. Last date to pay the fee: 23 December 2026.

age_limit.age_details: 21 to 33 years (on the last date fixed for submitting applications)

qualification.education_qualification: Direct candidates: science degree with Chemistry as one of the subjects from a recognised university. In-service candidates (Leading Fireman, Driver Mechanic, Fireman Driver, Fireman, Fitter Class-II of the department only): degree in any subject from a recognised university, with not less than 8 years of service.
qualification.details: Qualification: Direct candidates: science degree with Chemistry as one of the subjects from any recognised university; In-service candidates (Leading Fireman, Driver Mechanic, Fireman Driver, Fireman and Fitter Class-II of KSFES only): degree in any subject from any recognised university Experience: In-service candidates: not less than 08 years of service in the cadres of Leading Fireman, Driver Mechanic, Fireman Driver, Fireman and Fitter Class-II; probation satisfactorily completed; no departmental enquiry or criminal case at the time of applying Age limit: 21 to 33 years (on the last date fixed for submitting applications) Age relaxation: General Merit (Direct) Maximum 31 years, SC/ST/Cat-1/2A/2B/3A/3B (Direct) Maximum 33 years, General Merit (In-service) Maximum 43 years, SC/ST/Cat-1/2A/2B/3A/3B (In-service) Maximum 45 years, Ex-servicemen Period of service rendered plus additional 03 years, All Limits include one-time 5-year relaxation under G.O. dated 29.01.2026 | Other conditions: | Only male candidates may apply Minimum height 168 cm, chest 81 cm with 5 cm expansion, minimum weight 50 kg Must pass at least 3 of 5 physical fitness tests Compulsory Kannada test unless Kannada studied as first or second language in SSLC or Kannada test already passed Must be an Indian citizen

exam_pattern.details: Offline OMR type examination Absence in Paper-1 or Paper-2 leads to disqualification Written examination at selected centres in Bengaluru city Compulsory Kannada test: 150 marks, minimum 50 to qualify; marks not counted for selection

how_to_apply: Open the KEA website https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/ or https://ksfes.karnataka.gov.in/en.
Select the link given there and fill in the application online.
Enter the correct RD number of the caste / reservation certificate in the online form.
Pay the fee online only by 23.12.2026.
No change or correction is allowed once the application is submitted.
important_instructions: Post-wise and category-wise vacancy details are published separately and are tentative No allowance is paid for attending physical and medical tests Admit cards are not sent by post; download from the websites Balija and its sub-castes must claim Category 3(A) for employment

content_sections.heading: KSFES Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. ಸಿಬ್ಬಂದಿ(7)18/ನೇಮಕಾತಿ/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download KSFES notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Direct candidates: science degree with Chemistry as one of the subjects from any recognised university; In-service candidates (Leading Fireman, Driver Mechanic, Fireman Driver, Fireman and Fitter Class-II of KSFES only): degree in any subject from any recognised university Experience: In-service candidates: not less than 08 years of service in the cadres of Leading Fireman, Driver Mechanic, Fireman Driver, Fireman and Fitter Class-II; probation satisfactorily completed; no departmental enquiry or criminal case at the time of applying Age limit: 21 to 33 years (on the last date fixed for submitting applications) Age relaxation: General Merit (Direct) Maximum 31 years, SC/ST/Cat-1/2A/2B/3A/3B (Direct) Maximum 33 years, General Merit (In-service) Maximum 43 years, SC/ST/Cat-1/2A/2B/3A/3B (In-service) Maximum 45 years, Ex-servicemen Period of service rendered plus additional 03 years, All Limits include one-time 5-year relaxation under G.O. dated 29.01.2026 Other conditions: Only male candidates may apply Minimum height 168 cm, chest 81 cm with 5 cm expansion, minimum weight 50 kg Must pass at least 3 of 5 physical fitness tests Compulsory Kannada test unless Kannada studied as first or second language in SSLC or Kannada test already passed Must be an Indian citizen

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for KSFES Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates awaiting results of the qualifying examination on the last date Candidates with knock knees, flat foot or bow legs Persons permanently debarred by UPSC, KPSC, another State PSC or KEA Persons convicted of an offence involving moral turpitude or temporarily debarred, until Government reconsiders In-service candidates facing departmental enquiry or criminal case at the time of applying

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Probation of two years 06 months basic training at R.A. Mundkur Fire and Emergency Services Academy, Bengaluru or other fire colleges / institutions 06 months practical training at fire stations Candidates failing training examinations will be discharged from service National Pension Scheme (NPS) applies

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online only. Last date to pay the fee: 23 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will KSFES Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Physical Standard Test (PST) Physical Fitness Test (PFT) Written competitive examination (Paper-1 and Paper-2, offline OMR) Compulsory Kannada Language Test (for non-exempted candidates) Medical examination before the Medical Board Verification of original documents PST and PFT conducted by a committee chaired by the DGP and DG; only PST qualifiers take PFT Only PFT qualifiers are admitted to the written examination Paper-1 General Knowledge and Paper-2 Science and Aptitude, 100 marks each Total marks of Paper-1 and Paper-2 count for merit Candidates in the provisional selection list appear before the Medical Board (vision, hearing, chest X-ray)

content_sections.heading: KSFES Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Offline OMR type examination Absence in Paper-1 or Paper-2 leads to disqualification Written examination at selected centres in Bengaluru city Compulsory Kannada test: 150 marks, minimum 50 to qualify; marks not counted for selection

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Call letter and xerox copy of the submitted online application for physical tests One photo ID (Passport, Driving Licence, PAN, Service ID, bank pass book with photo, Aadhaar, EPIC and others listed) Caste / reservation certificate in Form D, E or F with RD number Original SSLC, PUC, degree marks cards and caste / reservation certificates at medical examination One set of xerox copies attested by a Gazetted Officer

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KSFES Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Open the KEA website https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/ or https://ksfes.karnataka.gov.in/en. Select the link given there and fill in the application online. Enter the correct RD number of the caste / reservation certificate in the online form. Pay the fee online only by 23.12.2026. No change or correction is allowed once the application is submitted. Apply on or before 22 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Post-wise and category-wise vacancy details are published separately and are tentative No allowance is paid for attending physical and medical tests Admit cards are not sent by post; download from the websites Balija and its sub-castes must claim Category 3(A) for employment

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for KSFES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 22 December 2026. Applications opened on 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in KSFES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 16 vacancies for Fire Station Officer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for KSFES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 22 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General Merit and other categories (Category-2A / 2B / 3A / 3B): Rs. 750. SC / ST / Category-1 / Ex-servicemen: Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 33 years (on the last date fixed for submitting applications). Relaxation: General Merit (Direct) Maximum 31 years, SC/ST/Cat-1/2A/2B/3A/3B (Direct) Maximum 33 years, General Merit (In-service) Maximum 43 years, SC/ST/Cat-1/2A/2B/3A/3B (In-service) Maximum 45 years, Ex-servicemen Period of service rendered plus additional 03 years, All Limits include one-time 5-year relaxation under G.O. dated 29.01.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay scale Rs. 54175-99400.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Direct candidates: science degree with Chemistry as one of the subjects from a recognised university. In-service candidates (Leading Fireman, Driver Mechanic, Fireman Driver, Fireman, Fitter Class-II of the department only): degree in any subject from a recognised university, with not less than 8 years of service.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only male candidates may apply. Minimum height 168 cm, chest 81 cm with 5 cm expansion, minimum weight 50 kg. Must pass at least 3 of 5 physical fitness tests. Compulsory Kannada test unless Kannada studied as first or second language in SSLC or Kannada test already passed.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates awaiting results of the qualifying examination on the last date. Candidates with knock knees, flat foot or bow legs. Persons permanently debarred by UPSC, KPSC, another State PSC or KEA. Persons convicted of an offence involving moral turpitude or temporarily debarred, until Government reconsiders.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Physical Standard Test (PST). Physical Fitness Test (PFT). Written competitive examination (Paper-1 and Paper-2, offline OMR). Compulsory Kannada Language Test (for non-exempted candidates).
